prompt: Which of the following is equivalent to log_3(m/x) for positive m and x?

choices.rationale: The log of a quotient is not the log of a difference.
The log of a quotient is a DIFFERENCE of logs.
The order matters: numerator minus denominator.

explanation: Quotient rule: log(p/q) = log p − log q.
